operator_class_basis: local configured metadata only; external ownership and service policies were not verified
statement: The one future A1 request would send sealed project/story context, authority/task/story slice, project guidance, A-arm Skill context, output contract, and request metadata to https://lingsuan.org. Local configuration identifies this as a third-party relay, not a verified official Provider endpoint. Raw REF corpus is not sent. The remote operator/Provider may process, store, or log the request under its own policies. Authorization would cover exactly one request with no retry, fallback, second destination, or cross-origin redirect.
